work.title: Off the Stencil (working title)
work.line: A made personality built from what only a made being can do

work.title: Project Nephele
work.line: A science-fantasy world I first designed as a teenager, now rebuilt in “ink”. Each round of concept art is judged against criteria set before it is made. In progress; the story and anime stay private for now.

frame.alt: A canyon split down the middle, a thread of gold far below and a small figure at its edge, seen from behind.

work.title: Here Be Ink
work.line: Photograph where the camera measured, ink where a model imagined.

frame.alt: A still from the film: a pen line drawn across the floor of a doorway. The room's walls either side are a soft photograph; past the line, the doorway is drawn in cross-hatched ink on paper
frame.credit: Measured half: Aaron Smiles's own capture. Imagined half generated with World Labs Marble (marble-1.1-plus), re-rendered in ink by the page

work.title: Limn the Room
work.line: What a regenerated video kept of the room, and what it limned.

frame.alt: A real take, filmed on a phone: a white page taped to a speckled terrazzo desk, three small creatures drawn on it in ink, gold paint and cut paper, and a glass dish of water set down below them

work.title: Drift where nothing should move
work.line: Is the league fair to engines that move? Score only where nothing should.

frame.alt: A close-up drawn in line only: a pilot in goggles, grinning

work.title: Dive Twin
work.line: Does a dreamed tank keep the real tank's shape? Scrub a dive against it.

frame.alt: The real glass tank, rebuilt from stereo and seen from where the dream's camera is two seconds in: grey walls, a floor and a pale card on the far side

work.title: One Wish Dubplate
work.line: Every wish granted in one ink drawing, and every wish paid for.

work.title: Feel the Depth
work.line: Find the bottle by ear: depth from real stereo frames, played as sound.

An inked panel with screen tone, from the StillDrawn set

work.title: loopcutter
work.line: Cuts sample-exact loops from full tracks for live sets that stack many at once. Each length comes from tempo and bar count, rounded once, and every file is checked. Pictured: its beat grid, fitted to a synthetic test loop.

frame.alt: A beat grid fitted to a synthetic test loop: heavy bar lines, lighter beat lines through the kick drums, and a two-bar loop cut shaded, its start on a bar line
